summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an Appendix 3H notification of cessation of securities, reporting the lapse of 2,932,881 unquoted performance rights because the conditions were not satisfied. No consideration was paid. The filing is a routine administrative update reflecting a forfeiture of equity-linked instruments, not a special situation event such as a buyback, tender offer, or restructuring. There is no price, premium, or strategic change involved. This is an ordinary capital-account disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
